title: CBM Capture Package Metadata
description: The `metadata` part of a multipart POST /cbm/capture request. Accompanies exactly one image part. Every pixel-space quantity in this document (camera.cx/cy/fx/fy, target.pixel) is expressed in the coordinate system of the image part that travels with it - never the sensor native frame, never the original pre-resize frame.

capture_id.description: Client-generated UUIDv4. Stable across upload retries; the server idempotency key. Maps to maintenance_requests.source_file_id.

building_id.description: Selects the MultiSet map and the IFC model. Must match CBM_BUILDING_ID server-side.

reporter_email.description: Identifies the reporting worker. Maps to maintenance_requests.reporter_email.

description.description: Free-text damage description typed by the worker. Supplements, never replaces, the vision model analysis.

captured_at.description: RFC 3339, UTC, from the device clock at shutter time. Not the upload time - an outbox item may upload days later.

device_model.description: Raw model identifier. Required for the per-device accuracy ablation in section 8 of the calibration note.

width.description: Width of the transmitted image part, measured after all transforms.

sha256.description: Hex SHA-256 of the transmitted image bytes. The server rejects the package if it disagrees.

orientation_applied.description: Quarter-turns clockwise already baked into the pixels, relative to the sensor native frame. The EXIF orientation tag is always 1 (normal): rotation is applied to the pixel data, not deferred to a tag, so that no downstream consumer can disagree about which frame K belongs to.

source_width.description: Sensor-native width before rotate/resize. Provenance only.

scale.description: Uniform downscale factor applied after rotation. Provenance only - K is already scaled.

camera.description: Pinhole intrinsics in the transmitted image pixel frame. Conventional CV notation (fx, fy, cx, cy); WF2 renames cx/cy to px/py when calling MultiSet and /elements/resolve-ray.

source.description: Provenance of K, in descending order of trust. Persisted so every resolved GlobalId can be audited by how its camera was calibrated.

trusted.description: False when K came from a fallback that failed the plausibility gate. A false value must route the request to NEEDS_LOCALIZATION rather than being silently unprojected.

skew.description: Camera2 reports a skew term; ARKit and ARCore are always 0. The IFC ray math ignores it - carried for completeness only.

width.description: Must equal image.width. The server enforces this.

lens.description: Which physical lens produced the frame, when the platform reports it.

distortion.description: Radial/tangential coefficients when available. Not applied in v1 - the pipeline assumes a pinhole model and gates on frame position instead.

target.description: Where the worker says the defect is. Replaces the vision model hallucinated bounding box as the ray origin pixel.

centrality.description: 0 at the frame centre, 1 at the edge, as max(|x/W-0.5|, |y/H-0.5|)/0.5. Section 6.2 of the calibration note rejects captures above ~0.6 because pinhole error grows toward the edge.

pose.description: ADVISORY ONLY in v1. The AR session own world pose. It is NOT in the MultiSet/IFC frame and must never be fed to /elements/resolve-ray; WF2 keeps deriving the trusted pose from MultiSet VPS. Carried so the two can be cross-checked offline.
